modes.name: Mode 2 - Reduced 8-bit
modes.summary: Same as Mode 1 but colour, zoom and dimmer are 8-bit (pan/tilt stay 16-bit).

modes.name: Basic 16-bit
modes.summary: 26 ch: coarse control of all effects with 16-bit pan/tilt and 16-bit gobo indexing on both gobo wheels.

modes.name: Extended 16-bit
modes.summary: 34 ch: Basic plus 16-bit dimmer, zoom and focus; last 5 channels reserved.

modes.name: Basic 16-bit
modes.summary: 32 ch: coarse control of all effects including framing, with 16-bit pan/tilt and gobo indexing.

modes.name: Extended 16-bit
modes.summary: 40 ch: Basic plus 16-bit dimmer, zoom and focus; last 5 channels reserved.

modes.name: Standard (single DMX mode)
modes.summary: The fixture has one 38 ch DMX mode: shutter, 16-bit dimmer, CMY, CTC, colour wheel, rotating gobo with 16-bit index, animation wheel, frost, iris, 16-bit zoom/focus, 4-blade framing, 16-bit pan/tilt, control and FX.

modes.name: Basic
modes.summary: 48 ch: 16-bit dimmer, CMY and CTC, colour wheel, two rotating gobo wheels with 16-bit index, animation, frost, prism, iris, 16-bit zoom/focus, 8-bit framing, 16-bit pan/tilt, control, P3 mix and FX.

modes.name: Extended
modes.summary: 58 ch: Basic plus 16-bit iris, 16-bit framing blade positions and angles and 16-bit framing module rotation.

modes.name: Compact
modes.summary: 42 ch: identical to Basic with the P3 Mix and FX channels removed (firmware 2.3.x and later).

modes.name: Compact
modes.summary: 17 ch: Beam and Aura controlled together: shutter, 16-bit dimmer and RGB, CTC, virtual colour wheel, zoom, 16-bit pan/tilt, control.

modes.name: Basic
modes.summary: 32 ch: separate Beam (shutter, 16-bit dimmer and RGB, CTC, virtual wheel, P3 mix) and Aura (shutter, 16-bit dimmer, RGB, CTC, virtual wheel, P3 mix) plus zoom, pan/tilt, control and FX.

modes.name: Extended
modes.summary: 89 ch: Basic plus individual 8-bit RGB for each of the 19 Beam pixels (channels 33-89).

modes.name: Ludicrous
modes.summary: 512 ch (a full universe): Extended plus individual 8-bit RGB for each of the 141 Aura pixels (channels 90-512).

modes.name: Compact Direct
modes.summary: 17 ch: Beam and Aura together with direct 16-bit RGBW instead of RGB/CTC/virtual wheel; zoom, 16-bit pan/tilt, control.

modes.name: Standard
modes.summary: 16 ch: colour wheel, stop/strobe, dimmer, static gobo, prism and rotation, effects movement, frost, focus, 16-bit pan/tilt, function, reset, lamp control.

modes.name: Vector
modes.summary: 20 ch: Standard plus pan/tilt time, colour time, beam time and gobo time channels.

modes.name: Standard (single DMX protocol)
modes.summary: The only published protocol, 31 ch: CMY, three colour wheels, stopper/strobe, 16-bit dimmer, static gobo, animation disk, rotating gobo with 16-bit rotation, 4 and 8 facet prisms, frost, zoom, 16-bit focus, beam/spot mode, 16-bit pan/tilt, function, reset, lamp.

modes.name: Standard
modes.summary: 30 ch: CMY, three colour wheels, stopper/strobe, 16-bit dimmer, static and rotating gobos, animation disk, prisms, frost, zoom, 16-bit focus, beam mode, 16-bit pan/tilt, function, reset, lamp control, macro effects.

modes.name: Vector
modes.summary: 34 ch: Standard plus pan/tilt time, colour time, beam time and gobo time channels.

modes.name: Standard (Basic Engine)
modes.summary: 21 ch: 16-bit RGBW, linear CTO, macro colour, strobe, 16-bit dimmer, 16-bit pan/tilt, function, reset, zoom and zoom (front lens) rotation.

modes.name: Shapes (Basic Engine)
modes.summary: 35 ch: Standard plus the shapes engine: shape selection, speed, fade, shape RGBW and dimmer, background dimmer, transition, offset, foreground/background strobe and background select.

modes.summary: Pixel engine block, 111 ch: individual RGB for each of the 37 LEDs. The pixel engine must be enabled through the FUNCTION channel (values 103-105).

modes.name: Pixel Engine RGBW
modes.summary: Pixel engine block, 148 ch: individual RGBW for each of the 37 LEDs. The pixel engine must be enabled through the FUNCTION channel (values 103-105).

modes.summary: Standard 18 ch mode: 16-bit pan/tilt, colour macros, 8-bit RGBW, shutter, dimmer, CTO, movement macros, zoom, pattern and direct pattern.

modes.summary: 14 ch mode: 16-bit pan/tilt, colour macros, RGBW, shutter, dimmer, zoom, special and pattern.

modes.name: High Resolution (Extended)
modes.summary: 19 ch mode with 16-bit RGBW and dimmer, shutter, zoom, special and pattern channels.

modes.summary: 11 ch: 16-bit tilt, beam intensity/duration/rate/shutter, special and grouped plate RGBW; no plate shutter effects.

modes.name: 33Ch
modes.summary: Full mode: 16-bit pan/tilt, dimmer, gobo index, focus and zoom; CMY, CTO, colour wheel, two gobo wheels, animation wheel, prism, iris, two frosts, CMY macros, control.

modes.name: 26Ch
modes.summary: Reduced mode: 16-bit pan/tilt only, 8-bit everything else; no auto focus or CMY macro channels.

modes.name: Single Control: Tour Mode (216-channel)

modes.name: Single Control: Advanced Mode (178-channel)
modes.summary: Single address, 178 ch: the 26 control channels plus 16-bit RGBW for each of 19 pixels.

modes.name: Single Control: Standard Mode (96-channel)
modes.summary: Single address, 96 ch: 20 control channels (8-bit dimmer and main RGBW) plus 8-bit RGBW for each of 19 pixels.

modes.name: Single Control: Basic Mode (20-channel)
modes.summary: Single address, 20 ch: 16-bit pan/tilt, CTC, colour and LED macros, background colour/dimmer, main dimmer, shutter, zoom, control and main RGBW; no pixel control.

modes.name: Dual Control: Advanced Movement Mode (26-channel)
modes.summary: Dual control movement address (used with a Dual Control pixel mode on a second address): the same 26 channels as the Tour/Advanced control block.

modes.name: Dual Control: Standard Movement Mode (20-channel)
modes.summary: Dual control movement address: the same 20 channels as Basic mode.

modes.name: Dual Control: Basic Movement Mode (8-channel)

modes.name: Dual Control: Advanced Pixels Mode (152-channel)
modes.summary: Dual control pixel address, 152 ch: 16-bit RGBW for each of 19 pixels.

modes.name: Dual Control: Standard Pixels Mode (76-channel)
modes.summary: Dual control pixel address, 76 ch: 8-bit RGBW for each of 19 pixels.

modes.name: Dual Control: Basic Pixels Mode (57-channel)

modes.name: Dmx Mode 39 CH
modes.summary: Full mode: 16-bit pan/tilt, dimmer, both rotating gobo indexes, focus and zoom; CMY, CTO, colour wheel, two rotating and one static gobo wheel, animation, two prisms, iris, two frosts, CRI filter, CMY macros.

modes.name: Dmx Mode 31 CH
modes.summary: Reduced mode: 16-bit pan/tilt, other attributes 8-bit; no auto focus or CMY macros.

modes.name: Dmx Mode 32 CH
modes.summary: Full mode: 16-bit pan/tilt, dimmer, gobo rotation, focus and zoom; CMY, CTO, colour wheel, rotating and static gobo wheels, animation wheel, prism, iris, frost, CMY macros, control.

modes.name: Dmx Mode 25 CH
modes.summary: Reduced mode: 16-bit pan/tilt, all other attributes 8-bit; no auto focus or CMY macros.

modes.name: 21CH

modes.name: 18CH
modes.summary: 16-bit pan/tilt, 8-bit dimmer; same effects as 21CH without movement macros.

modes.name: 56CH

modes.name: 55CH

modes.name: 54CH

modes.name: 54CH MS

modes.name: 33CH

modes.name: 33CH MS
modes.summary: 33 ch: same channels as 33CH but with the control channels first and the 8-bit RGBW zone channels at the end.

modes.name: 23CH

modes.name: 22CH

modes.name: 17CH
